qualifying.teaser: Danube launches fully furnished waterfront homes from AED 1.65 million.
qualifying.summary: Danube officially launched Shahrukhz Residences on 7 October 2026 as a fully furnished waterfront tower in Dubai Maritime City. Penthouses are designed by Gauri Khan.
